cases.title: Add bookmark to specific location
cases.description: Preconditions: Bookmarks hierarchy is open. Steps: Add a new bookmark into a specific location within the hierarchy. Expected behavior: The new bookmark is added to the specified location.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from file and access points
cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmark exists in the bookmarks file and access points. Steps: Delete the bookmark. Expected behavior: The bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file and no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add and delete bookmark from personal toolbar
cases.description: Preconditions: Personal toolbar is visible. Steps: Add a bookmark to the personal toolbar and then delete it. Expected behavior: The bookmark is successfully added to and deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder
cases.description: Preconditions: Bookmarks hierarchy is open. Steps: Insert a new bookmark folder into the bookmarks hierarchy. Expected behavior: The new bookmark folder is successfully inserted into the hierarchy.

cases.title: Launch bookmark in browser window
cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmark exists in the browser. Steps: Double-click on the bookmark. Expected behavior: The bookmark is launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks file links
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is packaged with the default bookmarks file. Steps: Check the default bookmarks file links. Expected behavior: Bookmarks within the default bookmarks file are valid links.

cases.title: Save changes to bookmark item
cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmark item exists. Steps: Make changes to the bookmark item and save. Expected behavior: Changes to the bookmark item are saved without loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete bookmarks folder
cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmarks folder exists. Steps: Delete the bookmarks folder. Expected behavior: The bookmarks folder is deleted.

cases.title: Add and delete bookmarks separators
cases.description: Preconditions: Bookmarks interface is open. Steps: Add bookmarks separators and then delete them. Expected behavior: Bookmarks separators are added and deleted.

cases.title: Save bookmark changes over restart or crash
cases.description: Preconditions: Bookmarks have been modified. Steps: Restart or simulate crash of the browser. Expected behavior: Bookmarks changes are saved over restart/crash.

cases.title: Negative view properties execution
cases.description: Preconditions: Bookmarks, folders, and separators exist. Steps: Attempt to execute view properties (negative test). Expected behavior: View properties execution behaves according to negative test requirements.

cases.title: Rename bookmark inline
cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmark exists. Steps: Rename the bookmark inline without using the bookmarks properties dialog. Expected behavior: The bookmark is renamed inline.

cases.title: Find bookmark using custom keyword
cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmark is configured with a user-defined custom keyword. Steps: Search for the bookmark using the custom keyword. Expected behavior: The bookmark is found using the user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Preconditions: Bookmark list with columns is displayed. Steps: Sort and reverse-sort bookmarks per column. Expected behavior: Bookmarks are sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize bookmark columns
cases.description: Preconditions: Bookmark columns are displayed. Steps: Resize bookmark columns to show/hide more of entries. Expected behavior: Bookmark columns are resizable to show/hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show and hide bookmark columns
cases.description: Preconditions: Bookmark columns interface is open. Steps: Show and hide bookmark columns. Expected behavior: Bookmark columns are showed and hidden.

cases.title: Delete several bookmarks at once
cases.description: Preconditions: Several bookmarks exist. Steps: Select and delete several bookmarks at one time. Expected behavior: Several bookmarks are deleted at one time.

cases.title: Prevent invalid bookmark drop targets
cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmark item, its immediate parent, and child exist. Steps: Attempt to drop a bookmark item onto itself, its immediate parent, or its immediate child. Expected behavior: It is not possible to drop the bookmark item onto itself or its immediate parent or child.

opinions.feedback: All cases are properly grounded in the provided requirements with clear preconditions, steps, and expected behaviors.
